row.title: Q-SELF-WORKER: the tick Worker measures k_self and the self regime
row.body: ingestDeploys keeps each deploy row's origin in the outcome evidence; windowFigures counts verified deploys whose origin is in seed/autonomy/criticality.json self.origins; computeKEff returns k_self, self_deploys and self_regime (subcritical, driven, self-sustaining); /live shows k_self and self_regime next to k_eff. Named self_regime because critloop.js already uses regime for subcritical, critical, supercritical.
